# dtcloud_vms (Data Source)

Lists the virtual machines in the active region and project.

The list endpoint returns a lighter record than the details endpoint -- no image, no SSH key, no timestamps -- so that is what this exposes. Use `dtcloud_vm` for the full picture of one instance.

Every filter is applied by the provider, not by the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every running machine.
data "dtcloud_vms" "running" {
  status = "ACTIVE"
}

# Everything attached to one security group -- the usual way to find what a rule
# change is about to affect.
data "dtcloud_vms" "behind_web_sg" {
  security_group_name = "web-tier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `security_group_name` (String) Only return VMs attached to this security group.
- `status` (String) Only return VMs in this status, e.g. ACTIVE or SHUTOFF.
- `task` (String) Only return VMs with this in-flight task.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vms` (List of Object) The matching virtual machines. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `ip_addresses` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `ram` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `storage` (Number)
- `task_state` (String)
- `vcpus` (Number)
- `volume_size` (Number)
